from: 0.21.0 Stage 1, manually accepted by user on desktop and phone
state: One live state-owner directory; no copied game model.
Seven persistence bookkeeping values moved to GameState.session with compatibility aliases.
One sealed save-subsystem registry and explicit historical order of 56 adapters.
saveCompatibility: Existing storage keys, schema:2 and subsystem schemas retained.
Existing stable IDs, item UIDs, fish IDs and inventory quantities are not renumbered or rewritten.
New saveVersion:1; legacy missing version migrates from 0; unsupported future formats reject before restore.
Direct restore validates a private copy before applying any subsystem. Save scheduling is suspended for the entire restore.

intentionalBugFix.baseline: 0.21.0 also fails to create a new game: missing power circuits in an early partial template.
intentionalBugFix.change: Capture complete initial defaults after all registrations and before the first slot load. Never build defaults from an already loaded game.
intentionalBugFix.balance: Initial balance and configuration values unchanged.

releaseMetadata: Version 0.22.0, changelog and existing version allowlist extended.
notInStage2: Gameplay tick/draw and input chains unchanged.
Indexed enemy/bed relationships and legacy payload field names retained; no multiplayer/networking or data-driven system rewrite.
